seed: A component off the Library lands on the timeline where it is let go, the way the title mock drags its lower third onto the Title track (video-title-wt.html, step 10). At Next defaults with no flag set: the sample recording is opened, the Library shown with the Catalog segment pressed and its Built for video filter turned off by the pointer, and the Badge starter tile carried onto V1 at five seconds. Held there, the lane draws the dashed ghost and says it goes on a new track, never over the recording. Let go, the badge lands on that new track from five seconds for three, picked, with the playhead on its in. One Undo takes the whole of it away, track and all. Dropped again over the badge's own new track after its end, it lands on that same track. Last, a double click on the tile still places one at the playhead, the way it did before the timeline took components.

steps.comment: View > Library, the way a person turns the shelf on, then the Catalog segment by the pointer.
Components are built for mockups, so the catalog keeps them behind its Built for video filter: turned off by the pointer, they join the shelf.
The six title tiles come first and the grid is lazy, so the shelf is searched for the tile, the way a person finds one.

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: the Badge tile held over the recording on V1 at five seconds. The lane draws the dashed ghost a file draws, three seconds long, and it says Component on a new track: a component is laid over the recording, never cut into it
THE SECOND TEST: let go, the badge is on a new track V2 from five seconds to eight, picked, and the playhead jumped to its in so it is on the picture
THE THIRD TEST: one Undo takes the badge and the track it made away together
Held over V2 at one second, where that track is free: the dashed ghost sits on V2 itself, three seconds long
THE FOURTH TEST: a second badge let go over V2 at one second, where that track is free, lands on V2 itself rather than making a third track

steps.comment: Let go over the picture instead: it arrives at the playhead, as it did before the timeline took components.

steps.note: THE FIFTH TEST: the Badge tile let go over the picture still places a copy at the playhead, three seconds long, as it did before
